base: The component slot holds only a pointer (bg3.exe+0x79A840: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 8) receives the address of a 0x20-byte ecl::PreviewEffectMap built by FUN_141c80640); the registry size 40 = object 0x20 + 8, as with the other objects stored behind a pointer. Script Extender already declares the object: ecl::PreviewEffectMap in GameDefinitions/Controllers/CharacterTask.h (LegacyMap<FixedString, PreviewEffectList*> Effects; bool Updating). The fields below are that object written with the primitive types generate.py knows.

fields.name: EffectsHashSize
fields.evidence: LegacyMap<FixedString, PreviewEffectList*>::HashSize (SE CoreLib/Base/LegacyMap.h MapInternals). FUN_141c80640 (bg3.exe+0x1C80640) writes 0xB; ecl::PreviewEffectMap::Begin/PlayEffect (Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xF40BC0/+0xF40D30) hash FixedString::GetHandle(key) % *(uint*)this. Live always 11.

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: padding before the bucket pointer; live holds garbage.

fields.name: EffectsHashTable
fields.evidence: LegacyMap bucket table: FUN_141c80640 allocates 11 zeroed node pointers; nodes are {next, FixedString key at +8, PreviewEffectList* value at +0x10} (Toolkit PlayEffect allocates the 0x18-byte node and the 0x18-byte value {NextEffectIndex, Array<EntityHandle>}). Live heap pointer.

fields.name: EffectsItemCount
fields.evidence: LegacyMap ItemCount: FUN_141c80640 writes 0. Live 1 in every sample.

fields.name: IsBeginCalled
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ecl::PreviewEffectMap::IsBeginCalled, game offset +0x18 (bg3.exe+0x18482C0); Begin() sets it to 1 and asserts 'Calling Begin() twice?', PlayEffect asserts it is set. FUN_141c80640 writes 0. Script Extender calls it 'Updating'.

fields.name: field_20
fields.evidence: Not part of the object: bg3.exe+0x79A840 allocates and constructs only 0x20 bytes; the registry size (40) is the object size + 8. Live holds unrelated heap bytes.

open_questions: Should the build expose the component as a pointer to Script Extender's existing ecl::PreviewEffectMap (CharacterTask.h) instead of this flattened copy? The generator cannot express LegacyMap, so the map is written as its three raw members.
second_pass: Established that the component slot is a pointer to an ecl::PreviewEffectMap (bg3.exe+0x79A840 allocates 0x20 bytes, stores 8): a LegacyMap<FixedString, PreviewEffectList*> (FUN_141c80640, Toolkit PreviewEffectMap::Begin/PlayEffect hash FixedString handles) plus the Toolkit-named IsBeginCalled flag at game offset +0x18; the LegacyMap is written as raw HashSize/HashTable/ItemCount because generate.py does not know the type.
